The parent function is

\[
f(x)=\ln(x).
\]

1. Both \(f\) and \(g\) have the same vertical asymptote, \(x=0\), so there is no horizontal shift.
2. The graph of \(g\) passes through \((1,4)\), while \(f(1)=\ln(1)=0\).
3. Thus, \(g\) is \(f\) shifted \(4\) units upward.

Therefore,

\[
\boxed{g(x)=\ln(x)+4}
\]
